# The NASDAQ:AMZN price of prices_of_a_currency_and_a_stock.txt given a new
# value through its guid, and nothing else.
#
# A key a block leaves out changes nothing, so the price keeps its time, its
# source and its type.
#
# What this fixture produces: that price, valued 220.00 USD.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_price_is_changed_through_its_guid.py.
price
	guid: "4a1a4c0c7328491fbde9f8099ba280c8"
	value: "22000/100"
